messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Study 1 was a 72-week trial comparing Zepbound weight loss with placebo in adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition, excluding patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight

Zepbound 10 mg | 19.5% | 45.5 lb | 233.2 lb

Placebo | 3.1% | 7.2 lb | 231.0 lb
Triplet: ["Zepbound Study 1", "enrolls patients with", "obesity or overweight"]

The relation 'enrolls patients with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject study includes or recruits patients who have the specified medical condition or characteristic.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
